_comment: Adopter overlay-exemption config (see docs/adopter-guide.md). List your OWN private-overlay directory NAME(s) in extra_exempt_dirs to keep that top-level directory out of the value-flagging content gates (the PII, secrets, and placeholder scanners) without editing tool source. Each entry is a bare directory name matched TOP-LEVEL-ANCHORED and DIRECTORY-ONLY: it exempts only a directory of that name directly under the repository root, never a nested directory, and never a file of that name. A shipped corpus/tooling directory name (or an absolute/multi-segment/empty value) is rejected and skipped with a warning, so the config can NEVER blind a gate over shipped library content. (Some corpus-integrity gates with their own file discovery may still validate your overlay's own documents; that is harmless and cannot expose your values.) The shipped library carries an empty list.
